summary.headline: Astrological Treatise Catalogue, Entries 94–107
summary.text: Catalog entries 94–107 for astrological treatises on purchasing slaves and goods, fixed stars, lunar configurations, injuries, fortunate and fallen nativities, life spans, prorogators, triangular sides, and lunar peripatoi, with cross-references to Parisinus 2506 and Valens.
